title: Area of Polygons and Pick's Theorem
summary: Splitting complex shapes into simpler ones, and counting pegs on a geoboard.
objectives: I can find the area of composite shapes by adding or subtracting parts.
I can find the area of a kite or rhombus from its diagonals.
I can use Pick's theorem on a grid.
misconceptions: You must use one formula for the whole shape.
Area and perimeter always change together.
Pick's theorem works for any shape, even with curved sides.
